case.summary: Alert HHG-017 was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.57 on online transaction 3450629 ($100.09) on card C04570-K1, elevated by a hidden proxy flag. In contrast, the calibrated second-generation fraud model scored the transaction at 0.014 with an expected historical fraud rate of only 0.6%. The purchase matches the holder's established baseline, directly aligning with two earlier purchases of approximately $100 for product R on the same device (D006670) within the preceding 70 minutes. Furthermore, the device and billing region under-index for fraud, the card has no association with any fraud ring or high-risk community, and its sole prior case (CC-1383) was cleared. The transaction is determined to be legitimate cardholder activity.
